'''''Huttese Ain't What It Used To Be''''' was an account of how the scripts associated with [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] had influenced the scripts of non-Basic speakers. It was written by [[Dribba Vermilic Scaiti]].
